title: Grandmas Hands
tuning: E A D G B E
content:
[Intro]
[Em7]
Hm

[Verse 1]
[Em7]Grandma's hands Clapped in church
on Sunday morning
Grandma's hands Played a tam-
[B7]bourine so well
[Em7]Grandma's hands Used to
issue out a warning She'd say,
[B7]"Billy don't you [A7]run so fast
[B7]Might fall on a [A7]piece of glass
[B7]"Might be snakes [A7]there in that grass"
[Em7]Grandma's hands

[Verse 2]
[Em7]Grandma's hands Soothed a
local unwed mother
Grandma's hands Used to ache
[B7]sometimes and swell
[Em7]Grandma's hands Used to
lift her face and tell her She'd say
[B7]"Baby, Grandma [A7]understands
[B7]That you [A7]really love that man
[B7]Put yourself in [A7]Jesus hands"
[Em7]Grandma's hands

[Verse 3]
[Em7]Grandma's hands Used to hand
me piece of candy
Grandma's hands Picked me up
[B7]each time I fell
[Em7]Grandma's hands Boy, they
really came in handy She'd say,
[B7]"Matty don' you [A7]whip that boy
[B7]What you want to [A7]spank him for?
[B7]He didn't drop no [A7]apple core" But I
[B7]don't have Grandma [A7]anymore
[B7]If I get to Heaven [A7]I'll look for
[Em7]Grandma's hands
Hm
